The '''FastFlesh medpac''' was an advanced [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]] manufactured by [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]].

==Description==
The FastFlesh [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]] was manufactured by [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]]. Intended for use by trained [[Medic/Legends|medics]] on the battlefield, the FastFlesh was equipped with [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]], [[body booster]]s, and [[Synthe-nutrient replicator/Legends|synthe-nutrient replicators]].<ref name="EGWT" /> The treatments in the FastFlesh medpac were so powerful that they could only be used once per day although other medpacs could be used in combination with the FastFlesh. It utilized a number of advanced synthetic biomedical chemicals such as BioTech's patented [[chromostring]] that allowed for deeper penetration of medicines into a patient's body without causing nerve damage.<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref>

A varied assortment of specialized medicines were included in the medpac, offering treatment to counter the effects of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]], [[Poison/Legends|poisons]], and [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve agents]]. To assist with field surgery, the FastFlesh included instruments such as a [[sonic scalpel]], [[laser cauterizer]], [[nerve regenerator]]s, [[tissue regenerator]]s, and a [[chromostring]] dispenser. The integrated [[medical diagnostic computer]] stored information on over five hundred different [[Species/Legends|species]], and was linked to a remote scanner and a [[substance analyzer]] that could identify various poisons, toxins, and unknown compounds.<ref name="EGWT" />
